CREATE TABLE fhir.patientAddress
(
    patient_id varchar(64),
    address_city varchar(64),
    address_country varchar(64),
    address_line varchar(64),
    address_postalCode varchar(64),
    address_state varchar(64),
    address_extension_extension_url varchar(64),
    address_extension_extension_valueDecimal float,
    address_extension_url varchar(100)
)
WITH( 
 HEAP, 
 DISTRIBUTION = REPLICATE
);

drop TABLE fhir.patientIdentifier;

CREATE TABLE fhir.patientIdentifier
(
    patient_id varchar(64),
    birthDate varchar(64),
    deceasedDateTime varchar(64),
    gender varchar(64),
    maritalStatus_text varchar(64),
    maritalStatus_coding_code varchar(64),
    maritalStatus_coding_display varchar(64),
    maritalStatus_coding_system varchar(64),
    multipleBirthBoolean bit,
    multipleBirthInteger bigint,
    resourceType varchar(64),
    text_div varchar(1000),
    text_status varchar(64),
    identifier_system varchar(100),
    identifier_type_coding_code varchar(64),
    identifier_type_coding_display varchar(64),
    identifier_type_coding_system varchar(64),
    identifier_type_text varchar(64),
    identifier_value varchar(64),
    name_family varchar(64),
    name_given varchar(64),
    name_prefix varchar(64),
    name_suffix varchar(64),
    name_use varchar(64),
    telecom_system varchar(64),
    telecom_use varchar(64),
    telecom_value varchar(64),
    communication_language_text varchar(64),
    communication_language_coding_code varchar(64),
    communication_language_coding_display varchar(64),
    communication_language_coding_system varchar(64)
)
WITH( 
 HEAP, 
 DISTRIBUTION = REPLICATE
);

drop table fhir.patientExtension;

CREATE TABLE fhir.patientExtension
(
    patient_id varchar(64),
    extension_url varchar(100),
    extension_valueAddress_city varchar(64),
    extension_valueAddress_country varchar(64),
    extension_valueAddress_state varchar(64),
    extension_valueDecimal float,
    extension_valueString varchar(64)
)
WITH( 
 HEAP, 
 DISTRIBUTION = REPLICATE
);

CREATE TABLE fhir.observationCategory
(
    observation_id varchar(64),
    category_code varchar(64),
    category_display varchar(64),
    category_system varchar(64),
    year int,
    month varchar(2),
    day varchar(2)
)
WITH( 
 CLUSTERED COLUMNSTORE INDEX, 
 DISTRIBUTION = HASH(observation_id)
);

    observation_id varchar(64),

drop TABLE staging.claimMain;

EXECUTE AS USER = 'ELTUser'
CREATE TABLE fhir.observationMain_new
WITH
(
 CLUSTERED COLUMNSTORE INDEX, 
 DISTRIBUTION = HASH(observation_id)
)
AS 
SELECT
observation_id,
    resourceType,
    issued,
    status,
    patient_id_reference,
    encounter_id_reference,
    effectiveDateTime,
    valueQuantity_code,
    valueQuantity_system,
    valueQuantity_unit,
    valueQuantity_value,
    valueString,
    cast(valueQuantity_value as int) as valueQuantity_valueInt,
    year,
    month,
    day
FROM    fhir.observationMain 
OPTION (LABEL = 'data_loads');
REVERT;

RENAME OBJECT fhir.observationMain TO [observationMain_old];
RENAME OBJECT fhir.observationMain_new TO [observationMain];

DROP TABLE fhir.observationMain_old;

(

    total_currency varchar(64),
    total_value float,
    [use] varchar(64),

    day varchar(2)
)
WITH( 
 DISTRIBUTION = ROUND_ROBIN,

);
